user.title: Acond heat pump
user.description: Enter the Modbus TCP connection details of the heat pump. Modbus TCP must be activated in the unit by the service department and enabled on the main page.

data_description.slave: Default is 1. Unit ID 2 is reserved for the HP cascade.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the temperatures are read, in seconds.
data_description.enable_circuit_2: Turn off when the unit has only one circuit.
data_description.enable_energy: Enable only when the unit implements these registers, otherwise the entities stay unavailable.
data_description.enable_silent: Enable only when the unit implements these registers, otherwise the entities stay unavailable.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open a TCP connection to the given address and port. Check the IP address, port 502 and that the unit is on the network.
error.no_response: The connection was established but the unit does not answer Modbus requests. Check that Modbus TCP is activated by service and ticked in the dark blue bar on the main page, and that the unit ID is correct (1).
error.modbus_error: The unit rejected the Modbus request (exception response). The Home Assistant log (filter: acond) names the failing registers, so some entities may stay unavailable.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log (filter: acond) for details.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.
